mapper.select: SELECT monitor_sys_gen_server_protocol as protocol, COUNT(*) as count FROM monitor_sys_gen_server GROUP BY monitor_sys_gen_server_protocol
SELECT monitor_sys_gen_server_status as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM monitor_sys_gen_server GROUP BY monitor_sys_gen_server_status
SELECT COALESCE(monitor_sys_gen_server_tags, '未分组') as tags, COUNT(*) as count FROM monitor_sys_gen_server GROUP BY monitor_sys_gen_server_tags

SELECT s.* FROM monitor_sys_gen_server s INNER JOIN monitor_sys_gen_server_setting st ON s.monitor_sys_gen_server_id = st.monitor_sys_gen_server_id WHERE st.monitor_sys_gen_server_setting_monitor_enabled = 1 AND s.monitor_sys_gen_server_status = 1 AND st.monitor_sys_gen_server_setting_status = 1
SELECT * FROM monitor_sys_gen_server WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tags}, '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_servers, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enabled_servers, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_monitor_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as monitoring_enabled, COUNT(DISTINCT monitor_sys_gen_server_protocol) as protocol_types, COUNT(DISTINCT monitor_sys_gen_server_tags) as tag_groups FROM monitor_sys_gen_server
